quote: The expression of maspin might be useful as a prognostic and possibly predictive factor for patients with particular types of cancer and data can guide physicians in selecting therapy.
summary: Review of maspin as a tumour suppressor and prognostic marker across cancers; no UC content.

quote: When used for stimulation of blood lymphocytes, ezrin, maspin, PRDX2, and hsp27 induced increased T cell activation in psoriasis patients, which was particularly evident for HLA-Cw6(+) individuals.
summary: Maspin is a candidate autoantigen that activated T cells from psoriasis patients; no UC or colitis result.

summary: SERPINB5 protein is one of many proteins up-regulated in colorectal adenomas and adenocarcinomas in a targeted proteomics screen.

quote: The second original hypothesis highlights the possible role of maspin in dysregulating the intestinal microbiota, in patients with idiopathic inflammatory bowel diseases (IBD) and inducing IBD-related CRC.
summary: Review of maspin localisation in colorectal cancer that hypothesises a role in IBD microbiota and IBD-related cancer.

summary: Maspin protein is overexpressed in active IBD and colitis-associated dysplasia compared with inactive IBD and normal mucosa.

quote: Immunohistochemistry of 26 tumor specimen confirmed upregulation of SerpinB5, thrombospondin B2 and secreted protein acidic-and-cysteine-rich.
summary: SerpinB5 protein is more abundant in colorectal cancer tissue than in matched normal mucosa by proteomics and immunohistochemistry.

quote: These results indicate, for the first time, that maspin is an anti-apoptotic protein in the colon.
summary: Maspin siRNA increased apoptosis in an apoptosis-resistant colon epithelial cell line, showing an anti-apoptotic role in colon carcinogenesis; no colitis outcome.

quote: In the present study, it was demonstrated that transforming growth factor β1 (TGF-β1) induced maspin expression at the transcript and protein levels in the human cervical carcinoma HeLa and human oral squamous carcinoma HSC4 cell lines.
summary: TGF-β1 induces maspin expression in cervical and oral carcinoma cell lines via Smad and non-Smad pathways; not UC.

quote: Patients who use nivolumab can prevent immune keratitis by testing MMPs and maspin.
summary: Case report proposing that monitoring maspin and MMPs may detect nivolumab-related keratitis; not UC.

quote: qRT-PCR analysis indicated a down-regulation of ABCG2 and an up-regulation of IL1RN, REG4, SERPINB5 and TRIM29 in the UC mouse model.
summary: SERPINB5 was identified as a key UC gene by WGCNA and was up-regulated in DSS colitis mice, more so at higher DSS dose.

quote: A total of 17 (p-value 9.091 × 10-05) functional variants in 12 genes (RETNLB, SCAI, ADH4, ESPL1, CPT2, FLG, PPP4R1, SERPINB5, ZNF66, ETAA1, EXO1 and CPA6) were associated with higher migraine risk
summary: A SERPINB5 variant is one of 17 exome variants associated with migraine risk in Arab women; not UC.

summary: Maspin is extensively expressed in serrated colorectal polyps but absent from normal mucosa and UC in remission.

summary: Maspin expression differs between two salivary gland carcinomas and tracks histologic grade; not UC.

quote: Meanwhile, SerpinB5 knockdown relieved symptoms of the mouse model of UC and repressed M1 macrophage polarization.
summary: SerpinB5 is raised in UC and its knockdown reduced inflammation, apoptosis and M1 polarisation in cells and DSS colitis mice.

summary: Correction notice for the SerpinB5 UC paper with no abstract or new data.

quote: Genetic ablation of SERPINB5 or pharmacological inhibition of MMP9 recapitulated the therapeutic effects of TSA, whereas MMP9 overexpression or RLN2 silencing partially reversed TSA-mediated protection in Caco-2 cells.

Helicobacter pylori pathogenesis review that does not discuss S100A8.

quote: As blockade of S100A8/A9 activity using small-molecule inhibitors or antibodies improves pathological conditions in murine models, the heterodimer has potential as a therapeutic target.
summary: Review of S100A8/A9 as an inflammation mediator, biomarker and therapeutic target in inflammatory diseases.

quote: S100A8, S100A9, and S100A12 are found at high concentrations in inflamed tissue, where neutrophils and monocytes belong to the most abundant cell types.
summary: Review describing phagocyte S100 proteins including S100A8 as proinflammatory damage-associated molecular patterns.

quote: MDSC also synthesize and secrete S100A8/A9 proteins that accumulate in the serum of tumor-bearing mice, and in vivo blocking of S100A8/A9 binding to MDSC using an anti-carboxylated glycan Ab reduces MDSC levels in blood and secondary lymphoid organs in mice with metastatic disease.
summary: S100A8/A9 sustains accumulation of myeloid-derived suppressor cells, and blocking its binding reduced them in tumour-bearing mice; not colitis.
Helicobacter pylori persistence review that does not mention S100A8.

quote: Recent studies revealed insights into biological functions of the CP subunits S100A8 and S100A9 during orchestration of an inflammatory response at mucosal surfaces across organ systems.
summary: Review of calprotectin (S100A8/S100A9) as a faecal biomarker of IBD and a regulator of mucosal inflammation.

quote: Finally, recent evidence using small molecule inhibitors for S100A8/A9 also suggests that blocking S100A8/A9 activity exerts beneficial effects on disease activity in animal models of autoimmune diseases including multiple sclerosis, systemic lupus erythematosus, rheumatoid arthritis and inflammatory bowel disease.
summary: Review of S100A8/A9 structure, biomarker use and therapeutic targeting, noting benefit of inhibitors in animal autoimmune models including IBD.

quote: Studies using bone marrow chimeric mice revealed that S100A8/A9 expression on myeloid cells is essential for development of colon tumors.
summary: Myeloid S100A8/A9 drove chemokine induction and colon tumour growth in mice, with S100A9 knockout reducing tumours; tumour rather than colitis outcome.
